  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "durationLabel" text NOT NULL,
  "durationMonths" int4 NOT NULL,
  "durationUnit" text DEFAULT 'MONTH' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,

  "price" int4 NOT NULL,
  "renewalPrice" int4,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

label: Give every existing package one option with its current length and prices

execute.description: packages without an option get one copied from their length, label, price and renewal price
execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."packageOption" ("packageId", "durationMonths", "durationUnit", "durationLabel", "price", "renewalPrice", "isActive", "createdAt", "updatedAt") SELECT p."id", p."durationMonths", p."durationUnit", p."durationLabel", p."price", p."renewalPrice", true, now(), now() FROM "public"."package" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."packageOption" o WHERE o."packageId" = p."id")

postcheck.description: every package has an option with its own length and price
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."package" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."packageOption" o WHERE o."packageId" = p."id" AND o."durationMonths" = p."durationMonths" AND o."price" = p."price")) AS "result"
